detail: Field probe v1 on agentic-platform-design reported 9,141,126 archived findings, including a single 2026-07-08 sweep of 328,657 entries (328,577 findings) spanning 0.8 days. Investigation: this is the KNOWN pre-1.24.0 auto-archive feedback loop (#35) — the archiver's own "Archive: N entries archived" summary finding re-armed the trigger. Fixed at source in server 1.24.0 (2026-07-04); repair pass shipped as twining_housekeeping({compact_archives: true}); that repo has not run it. CORRECTION TO THE REVIEW: I recommended replacing the archiver's cutoff=now default with an age-based cutoff. Against a store generating ~400k findings/day that would have exploded the live board and collapsed assemble — aggressive archiving was the immune response, not the disease. The recommendation survives only in the count-based form the adversarial verifier already specified (retain newest K, not before=now-Nd), because an age cutoff cannot bound a same-hour burst. Post-fix sweeps (07-11, 07-16, 07-23) are ~500 entries of genuine content and still show freshest_age 0.1-0.2 days, so H2 itself holds on clean data. Probe v2 now excludes loop junk from H2/H2b using the archive-compactor signature and reports it separately as H2c.
summary: Field data invalidates the review's archive recommendation: aggressive archiving was load-bearing against the #35 loop, and 9.1M "findings destroyed" is that loop's own exhaust, not lost knowledge
